newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Two dead in Melbourne city shooting.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Two dead in Melbourne city shooting.

text.p: Two people were killed and a third person critically injured in a shooting in a city building here on Wednesday, police said.
The shooting occured shortly after midday (0100 GMT) on the eighth floor of the building in the city centre, a police spokesman told Reuters.
Unconfirmed reports suggested the shooting took place in a suite used by a jeweller and that a fourth person may also have been assaulted, police said.
Police said they had cordoned off the eighth floor of the building and were searching for the gunman.
